events.verdict: Vincent (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position defending Barrett (NYK) and incidental contact occurs as the two players come together.
Butler (MIA) establishes himself in Barrett's (NYK) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Quickley (NYK) brings his hands toward Vincent (MIA) and marginal contact occurs as Quickley releases away to roll.
Vincent (MIA) initiates contact with Barrett's (NYK) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of a defensive goaltending is confirmed. Adebayo (MIA) makes contact with the ball after it hits the backboard above the rim and has a chance to score.
Barrett (NYK) brings his hand forward and marginal contact occurs with Herro's (MIA) arm at the start of the drive.
Grimes (NYK) brings his hands toward Butler (MIA) and marginal contact occurs as Grimes releases away to roll.
Herro (MIA) moves forward towards Barrett (NYK) and marginal body and arm contact occurs before the ball is deflected out of bounds.
Butler (MIA) dislodges the ball from Barrett (NYK) and is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Barrett (NYK) releases the throw-in within five seconds.
Adebayo (MIA) wraps an arm around Randle's (NYK) opposite side, affecting his FOM.
Randle (NYK) initiates contact with Adebayo's (MIA) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Grimes (NYK) establishes himself in Butler's (MIA) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Barrett (NYK) establishes his right foot as his pivot and maintains it.
Grimes (NYK) goes to, not through, Strus's (MIA) space and marginal contact occurs as the two come together as Grimes releases the pass.
Adebayo (MIA) firms up in a screening position in Barrett's (NYK) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Barrett (NYK) legally contests Herro's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Strus (MIA) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects Barrett's (NYK) pass prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Vincent (MIA) reaches in and marginal contact occurs with Hartenstein's (NYK) arm before he makes the pass.
Butler (MIA) establishes himself in Randle's (NYK) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Grimes (NYK) releases the throw-in within five seconds.

Replay review of the foul called on Adebayo (MIA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful.  Randle (NYK) loses his balance on his own and Adebayo avoids making any illegal contact.  MIA is given possession of the ball when play resumes.
Vincent (MIA) releases the throw-in within five seconds.
Herro (MIA) engages with Barrett (NYK) off-ball and marginal contact occurs as Herro releases away to retrieve the pass.
Randle (NYK) legally contests Herro's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
